component.name: DeepCool MYSTIQUE Control Hub
component.summary: Control your DeepCool MYSTIQUE cooler on Linux

description.p: DeepCool MYSTIQUE Control Hub is an independent Qt 6 application for managing supported DeepCool MYSTIQUE coolers on Linux.

ul.li: Manage and preview up to five GIF slots on the cooler.
Display live system metrics and adjust display brightness and rotation.
Select motherboard, temperature, and GIF motion RGB modes.
Inspect read-only hardware diagnostics and sensor status.
Start minimized in the KDE Plasma system tray.

description.p: The MYSTIQUE 360 ARGB (USB 3633:0009) has been tested on real hardware. Intel and NVIDIA sensor support has not yet been physically validated. The physical temperature-based RGB effect remains unconfirmed on the tested device; its pump LEDs remain white in that mode.
First-launch setup can permanently remove existing GIF and image files from the cooler after confirmation.
